fld_description: IFCB bin id (DYYYYMMDDTHHMMSS_IFCBnnn, the UTC start of the run); the id part of sample_key sccoos_ifcb-ctd:water:<id>.
UTC start of the run, parsed from the bin id and checked against Sample_time_PT converted from America/Los_Angeles (DST included). sample.datetime.
Provider cruise code: YYMM plus a 2-letter ship suffix (e.g. 2208BH). Not a CalCOFI cruise_key.
2-letter suffix of the cruise code; input to resolve_cruise_key() (question Q07).
YYYYMM designation built from the first four characters of the cruise code; the source-designation step of resolve_cruise_key().
CalCOFI line number.
CalCOFI station number.
CalCOFI station key 'LLL.L SSS.S', sprintf('%05.1f %05.1f', line, station).
Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).
Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).
CTD rosette bottle number the water came from; staging-only until the bin is linked to its bottle sample (question Q08).
Depth of the sampled bottle in meters; NULL for one bin (question Q05). Published as both depth_min_m and depth_max_m.
Provider depth class: 'Surface' or 'DCM' (deep chlorophyll maximum); staging-only.
Volume of seawater analysed for this bin in ml: 0.25 ml/min x (runTime - inhibitTime) / 60, per the provider notebook. Published as sample_measurement ifcb_volume_analyzed.
Pacific wall-clock time of the run (no time zone in the source); used only to check datetime_utc, not published.
IFCB bin id; FK to ifcb_sample.
Taxon name as the provider labels it (trimmed; 'Navicula ' carries a trailing space in the source, question Q10). Equals the WoRMS matched name for every taxon except 'unidentified cells'.
dataset_taxon.ds_taxa_code: Taxa verbatim, except 'unidentified cells' -> 'unidentified_cells' so the dataset-local taxon_key has no space.
Image-classifier class names merged into this taxon, '; '-separated; staging-only (not published).
Name matched in WoRMS; 17 names carry an underscore where WoRMS has a space (question Q10).
WoRMS AphiaID; NULL only for unidentified cells. Declared as worms_id in the dataset_taxon vocabulary.
Equivalent-spherical-diameter size class in um: '<10', '10-20', '20-40', '40>' (left-closed). Published as obs_attribute.bin_label.
Number of images (cells) classified to this taxon in this size class; obs_attribute.count. A chain-forming taxon imaged as one chain counts once (question Q11).
n_cells / volume_ml (asserted); summed over size classes into ifcb_abundance.
Mean cell biovolume in um3 (feature Biovolume / 3.4^3, per the provider notebook). 16 rows are 0 (question Q12).
Sample SD of cell biovolume in um3 (0 for a single image); staging-only.
Mean equivalent spherical diameter in um; staging-only.
Sample SD of ESD in um (0 for a single image); staging-only.
Version of the image classifier (1 on every row); staging-only.
Per-class classifier accuracy carried over from an earlier summary by class name; '; '-separated when classes are merged; blank for 2 taxa. Not published pending question Q06.
Volume analysed in ml (repeated on every row of a bin).
SUM of n_cells over the taxon's size classes in the bin (asserted to conserve every imaged cell).
SUM of abundance_ml over the size classes; obs.measurement_value for ifcb_abundance (cells/ml).
SUM(n_cells x avg_biovol_um3) / volume_ml; obs.measurement_value for ifcb_biovolume (um3/ml).
Size classes (1-4) in which the taxon was seen in this bin; staging-only.
IFCB bin id; the id part of sample_key.
ifcb_volume_analyzed (the only type).
Volume analysed in ml; sample_measurement.measurement_value.
